0022600030.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-4, fifth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, with a one-game losing streak) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 15th in the East, on a four-game losing streak) in Toronto's ninth game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation, averaging 19.5 points in 25.8 minutes per game this season) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Milwaukee is without Kam Jones (ankle).
